title: Manitoba couple awarded C$10,100 after years-long dispute with neighbour over roaming rescue dogs
summary_full: A Manitoba couple was awarded C$10,100 in damages due to ongoing issues with their neighbor's rescue dogs. Their neighbor's failure to control the animals led to numerous conflicts and trespassing incidents. The neighbor received C$1,000 for a separate incident involving broken dock boards. While both parties were found to have trespassed, the judge emphasized the difference in the nature of their actions.
